newsitem.title: USA: Investor raises concerns about Ashton.
newsitem.headline: Investor raises concerns about Ashton.

text.p: Robert Eprile, a director with a 9.9 percent stake in Ashton Technology Group Inc, said Friday he raised his concerns about Ashton and its management in three recent letters sent to the company.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Eprile is also identified as the president of Universal Trading Technologies Corp., a 80-percent-owned subsidiary of Ashton.

Eprile, who did not include a copy of the letters in the filing, said he is concerned that Ashton management is not taking the right steps to protect stockholders interest or enhance value of stockholder investments in the company.
Eprile said he intends to review his alternatives, including whether it was advisable to seek increased board representation or seek proxies and written consents from stockholders of Ashton.
He said he has not decided on which steps to take.
In September last year, Ashton won a contract from the Philadelphia Stock Exchange to develop a special trading system. It became a publicly traded company in May.
